Arguments of a Full OpenMx Matrix

Source: R/mxHelper-full-prep-matrices.R
MxHelperFullPrepMatrices.Rd

Builds the free elements, values, labels, and bounds of an m by n matrix for OpenMx::mxMatrix(). Labels and bounds of fixed elements are set to NA. The arguments are checked first; the internal version, without checks, is the one other projects copy.

Usage

MxHelperFullPrepMatrices(
  m,
  n,
  free_val,
  values,
  lbound_val,
  ubound_val,
  vec,
  name
)

Arguments

m

Positive integer. Number of rows.

n

Positive integer. Number of columns.

free_val

Logical vector or matrix, or NULL. Which elements are free parameters. A single value is recycled; NULL means all free.

values

Numeric vector or matrix, or NULL. Starting values. A single value is recycled; NULL means zeros.

lbound_val

Numeric vector or matrix, or NULL. Lower bounds of the free elements. A single value is recycled; NULL or NA means none.

ubound_val

Numeric vector or matrix, or NULL. Upper bounds of the free elements. A single value is recycled; NULL or NA means none.

vec

Logical. If TRUE, also return the bracket labels of the free elements, for a column vector of free parameters.

name

Character string. Name of the matrix or algebra.

Value

Returns a list with the elements free, values, labels, lbound, ubound, and vec (the bracket labels of the free elements, or FALSE when vec = FALSE).

See also

Other Full Matrix Functions: MxHelperFullBound(), MxHelperFullFixed(), MxHelperFullFree(), MxHelperFullLabels(), MxHelperFullMxMatrix(), MxHelperFullValues()

Author

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Examples

MxHelperFullPrepMatrices(
  m = 2,
  n = 2,
  free_val = NULL,
  values = NULL,
  lbound_val = NULL,
  ubound_val = NULL,
  vec = TRUE,
  name = "beta"
)
#> $free
#>      [,1] [,2]
#> [1,] TRUE TRUE
#> [2,] TRUE TRUE
#> 
#> $values
#>      [,1] [,2]
#> [1,]    0    0
#> [2,]    0    0
#> 
#> $labels
#>      [,1]       [,2]      
#> [1,] "beta_1_1" "beta_1_2"
#> [2,] "beta_2_1" "beta_2_2"
#> 
#> $lbound
#>      [,1] [,2]
#> [1,]   NA   NA
#> [2,]   NA   NA
#> 
#> $ubound
#>      [,1] [,2]
#> [1,]   NA   NA
#> [2,]   NA   NA
#> 
#> $vec
#>      [,1]        [,2]       
#> [1,] "beta[1,1]" "beta[1,2]"
#> [2,] "beta[2,1]" "beta[2,2]"
#>
